caveats: torch.ao.quantization is deprecated in torch 2.15 (torchao is the successor); it still runs here.
At ~2M parameters the model is small enough that quantize/dequantize overhead can outweigh the savings.
criterion: |val bpb(int8) - val bpb(fp32)| < 0.01 AND decode tokens/s(int8) > tokens/s(fp32), per run.
hypothesis: Dynamic int8 (torch.ao quantize_dynamic, qnnpack, nn.Linear only) changes validation bpb by less than 0.01 and raises cached greedy decode tokens/s on CPU.

protocol.decode: cached greedy, 64-token prompt + 64 new tokens, 5 repeats, median
protocol.modules: nn.Linear (qkv, proj, mlp, lm_head); embeddings fp32
protocol.val_bpb: full validation split, the project's own windowed evaluator
